tei:div.tei:p:
I adorn the awe-inspiring with a crown through the threefold sanctification of the day. The strong in might and greatness rejoice before Him in the house of assembly. They who praise in tumultuous throngs, laud Him with glorifying word. To Him who remembers piety for ever, do the Hayoth sing a new song. Praise Him alone — benevolent is He and forgives sins — on the day of the new moon. He suppresses wrath entirely and does not allow anger. O you (the angels) who serve Him in trembling and fear, praise Him who is awe-inspiring in the presence of those (Israel). Angels of fire encircled by the whirlwind, chant in honour of Him who
removes wrath. Angels of mystery, open your mouths to praise Him who sees all. Congregations of the holy people, praise Him, tumultuous myriads. Hearken to the loud blast of the Shofar that guilt may be forgiven.
